findings.description: Direct inspection of the current V30 front, sit, and crouch renders shows the deeper hem improves neutral coverage, but the front panels still ride above substantial portions of the shorts on raised thighs. In sit the broad shorts front remains exposed; in crouch the short layer remains visible under the lifted front apron and panel ends still meet in acute intersections. This remains a visible coverage failure.

Current front and rear neutral renders still show coarse angular facets and irregular folds across the skirt. The extended hem remains uneven and asymmetric, with pointed panel ends and abrupt crease transitions. The surface and silhouette are still visibly unfinished.
Direct inspection of the current rear render still does not reveal a clearly identifiable adjustment tab or buckle silhouette at the waist.

The existing render-current mesh showcase was regenerated from the exact current weighted-prototype blend and reports uvStatus MISSING. No substitute UV map was generated; authored UV coverage remains incomplete for this source.

sourceEvidence.currentPrototypeMotif: The current V30 hem-extension and fold-fairing correction improves the neutral hem reach, but directly inspected sit/crouch renders still expose substantial shorts and the panels remain angular. The source-bound mesh showcase from the current weighted prototype reports UV MISSING. Fit, Shape Keys, motion, Unity/VRChat runtime and release remain unverified.

meshShowcase.boundary: Base garment edges in neutral coordinates, not evaluated deformation or a topology/UV quality pass. Avatar meshes excluded by explicit garment role.

nextAction: Revise the sewn skirt pattern and construction so the front panels provide controlled continuous coverage in sit and crouch without pointed overlaps; improve skirt surface and hem topology; make the rear adjustment tab/buckle visually legible; and ensure every garment mesh has authored UV data. Then rebuild, inspect all five views and six poses directly, and regenerate the current source-bound topology/UV showcase. Fit, Shape Keys, Unity/VRChat execution, packaging, and release remain unverified.
